$comment: Decision-relevant provider facts for SBLA-003. Each fact was re-read from the cited official provider documentation on the access date. Strings labelled inference or operationalFallback are project conclusions, not provider promises.

providers.role: selected Release 1 static host and asset host

quotas.functionsNote: Shared Workers Free and Pages Functions quota; resets at midnight UTC. Release 1 does not use Functions.

costControl.providerFact: The cited Pages docs describe Free-plan limits and free, unlimited static asset requests; they do not describe automatic conversion of a Free Pages project to a paid plan.
costControl.projectDecision: Use only static Pages features. Do not add Pages Functions or a paid plan.

alerting.providerFact: Cloudflare documents usage-based billing notifications for Professional plans or higher and Pay-as-you-go accounts. The reviewed docs do not document a Free Pages build-count alert.
alerting.inference: Configurable 70% and 85% Pages-build alerts are not supported by the documented Free-plan controls.
alerting.operationalFallback: Review the Pages build count weekly. At 350 builds in a month, batch non-urgent changes; at 425, permit only correction or release-blocking builds until reset.

providers.role: considered but not selected for Release 1 asset delivery
providers.plan: Standard storage with monthly free tier and metered overage

quotas.freeTierCaveat: The free tier applies only to Standard storage, not Infrequent Access.

costControl.providerFact: R2 usage above the free tier is billed, and Cloudflare threshold billing automatically charges a payment method when accumulated usage charges reach the account threshold.
costControl.projectDecision: Do not activate R2 for Release 1 because the product plan forbids a service that can incur usage charges. Assets must remain within Pages limits or degrade to the 2D fallback.

alerting.providerFact: Cloudflare budget alerts use dollar thresholds, are informational, and do not pause or cap usage.
alerting.projectDecision: No R2 alerts are configured because R2 is not activated. Alerts cannot substitute for the required hard no-charge boundary.

quotas.buildsPerHour: 10 soft limit; not applicable when publishing with a custom GitHub Actions workflow
quotas.usageRestriction: not intended for or allowed as free hosting for an online business, e-commerce site, or commercial SaaS

alerting.providerFact: The Pages limits page says GitHub Support may email when quotas are exceeded; it does not document configurable 70% or 85% Pages bandwidth alerts.
alerting.inference: The requested thresholds are not supported for GitHub Pages in the reviewed documentation.

providers.role: portability alternative considered and not selected

quotas.derivedBandwidthCeiling: 15 GB/month if all 300 credits were used for bandwidth; requests and production deploys reduce it
quotas.hardLimit: The Free plan has hard monthly limits that cannot be exceeded or incur costs.

alerting.providerFact: Free-plan usage notices are fixed at 50%, 75%, and 100%.
alerting.inference: Exact 70% and 85% thresholds are not configurable in the documented Free plan.

providers.role: selected optional Release 1 aggregate pageview analytics

quotas.cookies: does not use client-side state such as cookies or localStorage
quotas.fingerprinting: does not fingerprint individuals via IP address, User Agent, or other data
quotas.ingestion: the beacon fires on every pageview and every received beacon is recorded without ingestion sampling
quotas.retention: unsampled beacon data for 7 days; after 7 days data is aggregated to around 10%
quotas.querySampling: between 0.0001% and 100%, dynamically selected by filter and matching-row volume
quotas.documentedIngestionQuota: none found in the reviewed official pages; this is not a claim of unlimited capacity
quotas.customEvents: NOT ESTABLISHED - the reviewed documentation did not establish support for the seven controlled Release 1 custom event names

measuredTransfer.measurement: curl response from static.cloudflareinsights.com with Accept-Encoding: gzip on 2026-09-01; cache-control max-age=86400
measuredTransfer.beaconPayloadBytes: not measured because no production analytics site/token exists
